Scientific Instruments Change - Laurentian Fan
Wave Glider C34167NS is transiting from 43 24.694 N 056 23.710 W to 43 34.212 N 058 47.576 W.
Wave glider C34164NS is copper in colour with a mast extending 1.2 metres above the surface of the water, supporting a solid white light and orange visibility flag and is equipped with a non-transmitting ais receiver. It is remotely operated, moving at a speed of approximately 1.2 knots and measuring 3.05 metres by 0.81 metres.
For further information, authorities and mariners may contact sue l’orsa at 250-877-8052, tyler byrne at 902-719-7078, or liquid robotics wave glider operations centre at +1 888-574-4574 or 408-636-420
